scope: Eight explicitly selected source-only native owner context-owner/context-provider guards, hook facade and adapters at their current native paths. All nine former Codex src/legacy implementation paths are retired by the paired source successor after complete caller migration; historical originals, source objects, release and receipt compatibility remain in their existing custody. No native state, original transcripts, credentials or historical private fixture bytes. The paired reviewed fixture is staged before native-owner CAS; refresh grants no active owner authority.
requiredOrder: Run verify before changing common package manifests or owner source registrations.
On hash drift, inspect the exact finite owner source changes and source-owner decisions.
Refresh only the listed bounded own-code sources and SHA256 manifest; hosted CI refuses refresh.
Independently review the source fixture and manifest diff alongside the owner source successor.
Run the full QA source checks and preserve the result before exact-head native independent review.
failureRule: A partially available live source set, source symlink, oversized source or hash drift fails closed. In the hosted checkout, no live owner set is claimed; the pinned finite source fixtures are checked exactly.
qaIdentityOverlay: Only the disposable QA project sourceOwnerRoot, registration roots and registration hash markers are changed. Production source and guards retain their existing owners.
